message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine, dated "EDISI 1-7 Desember 2003," features a large, brown flying carpet. The carpet is patterned with dark, intricate swirls and has yellow tassels at its corners. It carries dozens of small human figures, most wearing white robes draped over one shoulder. Many figures are crowded together atop the carpet, while others are falling off its edges.

A larger male figure in the lower right foreground, also wearing a white robe, reaches upward with open hands toward the carpet. Below the carpet, several other white-robed figures are shown in mid-air, falling toward the bottom of the frame with their limbs splayed.

The background is a solid, warm tan or ochre color. At the top, yellow text reads, "Menteri Boediono tentang Pengganti BPPN," above the white "TEMPO" masthead. Centered below the masthead is the yellow headline "Berebut Tiket ke Tanah Suci." A barcode and the price "Rp 14.700" are visible at the bottom. The entire image is enclosed within a thin red rectangular border.
